name.description: Optional name locally unique to the parent {@link FlowGraph}. Useful for user-facing APIs such as visualization.

inTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

outTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

parents.description:
ids of parent vertices in {@Workflow#parent} {@link FlowGraph}. NOTE: there can be multiple in the case
that several vertices in the parent {@link FlowGraph} were merged as part of translation to a single vertex
in the new graph.

timeout.description:
Timeout for the execution of the vertex. After timeout time has passed the vertex execution fails if not
successfully completed or failed already.

nodePool.description:
If {@link App.NodePool} is provided, then a server node matching this profile will be identified such that
the action is executed there.

hardwareConstraint.description: The constraints need to be met for executing this action.

requirementOverride.description: Overrides the action requirement associated with the {@link #action}, to be used for action execution

title:
A specialized {@link Workflow.Vertex} that represents a {@link ActionRef}.
Every {@link Workflow.Action} has multiple input ports: a port "$start" and a number of ports whose names
match the arguments to the configured {@link #action}.
Every {@link Workflow.Action} has three output ports: an optional port "out", a port "$success", and a port "error".
The "out" output represents the return value of the {@link #action}, if any.
See {@link Workflow} for more details on ports "$start", "$success", and "error".
```
-------------------                            ---------------------
| Workflow.Action | $success --------> $start  |                   | $success --------> ...
-------------------                            |                   |
                                               |  Workflow.Action  | error -----------> ...
-------------------                            |                   |                       -------------------
| Workflow.Input  | out -------------> arg1    |                   | out -------------> in | Workflow.Output |
-------------------                            ---------------------                       -------------------
```
name: Workflow.Action
